err_wrong_columns_norow: A row has {got} columns but {expected} were expected: “{text}”. Check the separator or enable “Skip malformed rows”.
err_not_utf8: The text is not valid UTF-8. Choose the “Windows-1252 (ANSI)” encoding.
err_permission: No permission to read or write (is the file open in Excel?).
note_encoding_adjusted: Encoding switched to Windows-1252 (there were non-UTF-8 characters).
note_text_columns: Read as text because of mixed values: {columns}.
note_mixed_columns: Stored as text because of mixed values: {items}.
err_json_not_json: The file doesn't look like JSON: it should start with “[” (list) or “{” (object).
err_json_incomplete: The JSON is incomplete or malformed: a string, “]” or “}” is not closed.
err_json_expected_colon: The JSON is malformed: expected “:” after “{key}”.
err_json_scalars: The JSON is a list of plain values: a table needs objects ([{"value": 1}, …]).
err_json_after_item: The JSON is malformed after item {n} of the list.
err_json_expected_key: The JSON is malformed: expected a key name in quotes.
err_json_trailing: There is content after the end of the JSON. If it has one object per line, save the file as .jsonl.
err_json_in_list: The JSON is malformed inside a list.
err_json_bad_line: Line {n} is not a valid JSON object (“{text}”). Fix it or enable “Skip malformed rows”.
err_json_bad_item: Item {n} of the list is not a valid JSON object (“{text}”). Fix it or enable “Skip malformed rows”.
err_json_empty_objects: The JSON objects are empty: there are no columns to convert.
err_json_no_records: The JSON contains no records (the list is empty).
err_json_preview_no_record: No complete record found at the start of the file.
err_value_type: The value “{value}” in column “{column}” (record {row}) doesn't match its type.
log_combined_exists: {path} already exists. Enable “Overwrite” to replace it.
log_combined_text_columns: Columns with different types across files, stored as text: {columns}.
cli_no_files: No CSV or JSON files found.
app_subtitle_web: Converts CSV and JSON files to Apache Parquet in the browser, without installing anything.
app_badge_web: Works offline. Your files never leave this computer.
dst_download: Download (one .parquet, or a .zip if there are several)

dst_next_to_hint: Available when you choose the source folder with “Choose folder…” or drop it here (Edge or Chrome).
dst_folder_failed: That folder can't be used ({error}). If your organization blocks folder access, choose “Download”.
split_hint_web: Each result goes into a folder with its parts. In MB the size is approximate.
files_empty_text: Choose one or more CSV or JSON files, or a whole folder, in the panel on the left.

status_searching_in: Looking for CSV and JSON files in “{name}”…
status_searching: Looking for CSV and JSON files…
log_picker_fallback: The browser did not allow opening the folder ({error}). Using the classic picker.
log_drop_failed: Could not read what you dropped: {error}
err_zip_too_big: The .zip would be larger than 4 GB. Use “Save to a folder” (Edge or Chrome).
err_no_permission_dest: No permission to write to the destination folder. Choose it again.
err_no_permission_root: No permission to write to “{name}”. Accept the permission or choose another destination.
err_same_output: Produces the same Parquet as “{other}”. Enable “Keep the source subfolders” or rename one of them.
result_downloaded: The browser has downloaded the result.
result_saved_next_to: Saved next to each source file.
result_errors_hint: Select a file with errors to see the reason.
log_download_only: This browser can't write to folders: the results will be downloaded.
err_gz_unsupported: This browser can't decompress .gz files. Use an up-to-date Edge, Chrome or Firefox.
err_gz_damaged: The .gz file is damaged or isn't gzip.
err_unclosed_quote: There are unclosed quotes starting at record {row}. Check that value or the chosen separator.
err_wrong_columns: Record {row} has {got} columns but {expected} were expected: “{text}”. Check the separator or enable “Skip malformed rows”.
err_json_single_too_big: The JSON is a single object larger than 64 MB with no list of records inside.
err_value_changed: The value “{value}” in column “{column}” (record {row}) doesn't match its type. Did the file change during the conversion?
err_no_columns: The file has no columns to convert.
err_files_no_columns: The files have no columns to convert.
err_write_permission: No permission to write to the folder. Choose it again and accept the permission.
err_read_failed: Could not read the file. Was it moved or deleted, or is it open and locked by another program?
err_disk_full: There is not enough disk space.
err_target_locked: The destination file is locked (is it open in another program?).
err_out_of_memory: The browser ran out of memory. Try “Save to a folder” or split the file.
